verdict.why: SCOPED TO THE DECLARED DOMAIN -- this arm AS THE ENTRY GATE. Every row is measured, so not INCOMPLETE; the defect blocks load-bearing use rather than bounding it, so not QUALIFIED. Three independent grounds, any one sufficient: (1) CADENCE -- one draw where clause 1 requires a distribution at N >= 20; (2) KEY -- a shared RNG stream makes the draw order-dependent on an unrelated battery, so the value is not reproducible under any edit above it; (3) PERSISTENCE -- a primary input is untracked, so re-run is device-dependent, and content-pinned is not commit-pinned. NONE OF THIS IMPEACHES THE DIAGNOSTIC FINDING the arm was written for: firm-blindness is the mechanism, 1i read that at source and adopted it, and this card does not disturb it. REMEDIES ROUTED AND ANSWERED WITHIN THE HOUR, recorded here so this card does not read as an open question it no longer is: 1i(iii) DISCHARGED @2c349e88dc; owner disposition 1.0.0_SA_CTO~Y 82680 recorded @77cfaac66e. The remedies do NOT move together. 1.0.0_SA_CTO~Y holds methodology / persistence / location / key -- a per-arm independently seeded RNG with the seed DECLARED on the oracle, (K,T)=(20,20) declared as the carded arm, and -- CORRECTING THIS CARD'S OWN FRAMING -- a PERSISTENCE remedy that is a CITATION rather than a repo write: the primary input is the SERVED artifact at its immutable run-addressed S3 URI bearing the same sha256, the local .tmp- copy is a CACHE and never the cited input, and the 2.6 MB gitignored blob is NOT committed. 1i(iii)'s bar now reads 'tracked, commit-pinned, OR served at an immutable run-addressed URI with its digest'. 2.0.0_SA_COO~X holds cadence / coverage / failure_mode -- the N>=20 typed battery and the SCALE -- at the post-wave-3 cut. GROUND (3) STANDS AS A FINDING about the instrument AS WRITTEN, which cites a local path; only its REMEDY is superseded. This SHARPENS rather than refutes the card's own line that content-addressed is not retrievable: a digest plus a RESOLVABLE URI is retrievable, a digest alone is not. Standing stays UNSOUND -- it scores the arm as it exists at c11d1ff734, and the clause-1 instrument is REBUILT at the cut, not reused.
